flow.label: Steps
flow.history.title: Confirm your field's history
flow.history.body: ITZA will read the seasons the satellites saw on your field and ask you to confirm which crop grew each year.
flow.inputs.title: Tell us how you farm
flow.inputs.body: Your current rotation, soil, priorities and limits shape which rotations are worth comparing.
flow.compare.title: Compare rotations
flow.compare.body: Each rotation is replayed through every real season on record, so you can see which one would have held up best.
flow.pending: This step is built in a later release. Your field is saved and will be here when it arrives.
flow.needField: Draw your field on the map first.
